shared_elements: human head/figure with striated wig or headdress
incised parallel-line hatching to indicate hair
human figures shown with schematic, blocky anatomy
justification: Both show human figures whose hair or headdress is rendered as a mass of fine parallel incised striations over a rounded head, a moderately specific shared convention, and both treat the body in a blocky, schematic way. However, B is a legible flat composition of profile figures flanking a heaped offering table with a staff-bearer and sign-like marks below, while A is a three-dimensional, fragmentary sculptural mass with no comparable scene, table, offerings or registers, so relationships and arrangement scarcely correspond.
